payload.name: Representation responsibility boundary
payload.statement: Conceptual reading renders accepted meaning and provenance without creating mutation authority. Inspection of execution instructions additionally binds exact rendered bytes to the selected plan revision, capsule, normative kernel, representation profile and state dependencies, and retains approval identity and status when one exists; inspection must also work before approval. Authorized execution separately requires a current authenticated approval and live dependency validation. Report artifact integrity, dependency freshness, semantic fidelity, execution authorization and delivery as separate facts. Unknown currentness never grants permission. Returning exact instructions to an active runner or tool channel proves that delivery stage only, not agent understanding, compliance or behavioral success.
